summary: Evidence verifier: lane definitions (required-lanes file) with definition_changed and wrong_definition; nothing reads them yet

schema.detail: No daemon claim or portable record change.

rules.detail: A new base-owned file .st/required-lanes.json and an opt-in --lanes-from flag of scripts/evidence-verify hold a check to its lane: the lane's script blobs must be identical in the verified tree and at the accepted base (definition_changed) and the note must carry the base's lane_definition_sha256 (wrong_definition). No producer writes the digest, no gate or workflow passes the flag, every enforce stays false and no committed check requires a note, so no job is skipped or rejected by this change.

compatibility.detail: Without --lanes-from the verifier behaves exactly as before.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the previous verifier; no state is written.
